title: Odds volatility
description: How jumpy this venue's odds of Up have been, in probability points. Jumpy odds mean the venue is repricing hard on every tick.

volatility_pp_1m.label: Volatility 1m
volatility_pp_1m.description: The spread of changes in the odds over the last minute, in probability points. Bigger means the venue is swinging more.

volatility_pp_5m.label: Volatility 5m
volatility_pp_5m.description: The spread of changes in the odds over the last five minutes, in probability points. The baseline the one-minute read is compared with.

regime.label: Odds regime
regime.description: Rising when the last minute is jumpier than the last five, falling when calmer, steady in between. Rising means the venue is getting nervous.
